description: This file declares the class AdbWinUsbIOCompletion, which encapsulates a wrapper around the OVERLAPPED Win32 structure for asynchronous I/O requests via WinUsb API. It includes methods for constructing, releasing, and retrieving overlapped I/O results, and references external classes related to USB endpoint objects and I/O completion.

classes.name: AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
classes.description: A class that manages overlapped I/O completion for WinUsb API, including construction, destruction, and result retrieval.

methods.name: AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the object with parent I/O object, expected transfer size, and event handle.

methods.name: ~AdbWinUsbIOCompletion
methods.description: Destructor, hidden to prevent stack allocation.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Releases the object, managing reference count and ensuring deletion in the correct module context.

methods.name: GetOvelappedIoResult
methods.description: Retrieves the result of an overlapped I/O operation using WinUsb_GetOverlappedResult.
